silhouetteRule: Osmanth Image: a square body with floppy ears, carrying a set square - the only triangle in the family, which is what keeps it legible once the tick marks disappear at small sizes. The square body is measured rather than chosen for looks: the derived silhouette sat 0.0304 from Osmanth Video's. Inherits the family's eye language, outline weight and corner softness.

accessories.name: setsquare
accessories.description: Osmanth Image prop - what this site actually does, in one object.

forbiddenChanges: Never change the square body shape or the head-to-body ratio by more than 10%.
Never recolour the body away from #15471b; seasonal palettes swap accents only.
Never change eye style from "round" - expressions swap the eye state, not the eye design.
Never remove or restyle the floppy ears.
Never add fingers, detailed teeth, or realistic shading.
Never render the character with a visible nose if the Bible says it has none.
promptAnchor: Osmanth, a helper creature mascot: square body, floppy ears, round eyes, smile arc mouth, flat #15471b body with #2e261a outline, minimal detail, transparent background, no text, no gradients, no realistic shading
